text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!
Ramonu-sama lost, huh...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Even so, her presence is just on another level.
No matter where she is, she catches your eye...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Totally. The winner probably didn't have much room to spare either.
She's only going to grow even more from here next year.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Aren't they going to get her into top form for the Oka Sho?
Could it be that she might actually... achieve the Triple Tiara—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
More, even more...
Unless I love them even more, it won't be enough, will it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Next time...
I will give you everything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I will give it everything I have...
Next time, for sure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...However—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ramonu-san.
She carries herself with such poise.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Her heart is... so strong, too.
—I can't help but admire her...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, incredible...
Ramonu-san is so cool...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To think I'll be able to chase that back again next year...
I'm so happy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...This heat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—More...
I can yearn even more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's there.
Surely... right over there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Along the path
that revolves around the Tiara...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her first GⅠ race,
Mejiro Ramonu was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There is only one thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I'll use all the time I have left.
To tune this body... to utter perfection...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The races to challenge in next year's Classic year... the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho. —The goal is a clean sweep: the Triple Tiara.
choice_data_list: First, the first race: the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only once in a lifetime...
The chance to seize that brilliance comes only once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent passion
will surely be born.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her prophetic words send shivers down my spine...
Something big is bound to happen on next year's Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a foolish question to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—I'm looking forward to it.
Very much so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, aiming for the first-ever Triple Tiara
in the upcoming Classic season...
she takes on the challenge of the "Oka Sho"!
